calibration_design.arm_drift_audits: separate blinded arm-specific positive, negative, and division checks trigger fail-closed QC and are not used to recalibrate
calibration_design.shared_panel_role: one reusable external truth-labeled panel sampled once per synthetic study and used for both-arm correction; it is not regenerated per arm or comparison
calibration_design.truth_establishment: reference labels are assumed established independently of treatment assignment and blinded to the benchmark analyst

claim_boundary: Paired fixed-cohort first-attempt aggregate-count stress test only; pre-division death is inseparable from other non-completion, later daughter outcomes are secondary, and this is not a timestamped lineage model, biological validation, or efficacy evidence.

design.interval_method: paired edit-event log-ratio interval with predeclared small-sample multiplier
primary_estimands: conditional error per completed first division
error-bearing completed first division per enrolled founder
